failures.assertion: assert len(puts) >= 2, 'the reader of the channel never put a frame'
failures.detail: The fixture of the subcase delivers its second frame only after the release of the owner and the owner sets that release after the tightening; the reader of the fixture can therefore return the end of the stream instead of the second frame and the drain ends before the second put.  The instrumentation of the put was installed after the channel had already autostarted.  The premise of the subcase was not established and the assertion is right to fail.
failures.observed: puts == [0.5]: exactly one put, the unbounded one
failures.phase_documents: none (the correction 05 group writes no phase document)

failures.assertion: assert not [item for item in _launcher_custody_items() if item['kind'] == 'aggregate']
failures.classification: TEST_ASSERTION_SCOPE_DEFECT; the remaining entry is UNKNOWN
failures.detail: The assertion is about the global table of the launcher, which the whole session shares with the nodes of the corrections 03 and 05; it does not inspect which entries belong to this node and the evidence of the batch does not name the entry that remained.  The M08-E behaviour of the node itself is proven by f5-r13-launch-stop.json and f5-r13-launch-cleanup.json.
failures.observed: one aggregate of the GLOBAL table of the launcher remained; the two M08-E subcases of the node passed

failures.assertion: assert channel is not None, 'the partial channel lost its owner'
failures.detail: The fixture injects the interruption of the return of Thread.start after the thread really started; that does not prove that the reader of the channel is still inside its read, and the thread of the channel may complete and release the channel correctly before the cleanup runs.  The node wrote no phase document, so the artefacts of this batch do not show whether the reader was alive at the close.  A fixture premise defect and a production behaviour of the aggregate cannot be distinguished by this evidence.  The production review of the same blobs finds M07 OPEN (M07-A.1, M07-A.2, M07-A.3) and this evidence closes none of them.
failures.observed: the aggregate did not hold the half-built channel after the adoption: the close of the partial channel returned complete facts

failures.detail: The second release should have retried the raw stream and propagated the original KeyboardInterrupt and it returned normally.  The node wrote no phase document, so the exact error path through the helper, the aggregate and the table is not established by this batch.  Two production paths are candidates and neither is proven: the refusal of a new raw close when the current bound is expired (the bound of that release is the global table's context, which an earlier node had already published and whose cleanup deadline had expired by then) and the M07-A.2 residual of the production review (a cancellation inside the helper discards the already confirmed facts).
failures.observed: DID NOT RAISE; the first release of the raw stream really happened (attempts 1, confirmed 0)
failures.phase_documents: n10-r05-adoption, n10-r05-recovery, n10-r05-retained-recovery (RUN); the new subcase wrote none

failures.assertion: TypeError: recording_get() got an unexpected keyword argument 'block'
failures.detail: The production calls get_nowait(), which calls get(block=False); the wrapper of the test broke the non-blocking observation of the queue of the startup owner.  The wrapper must forward the block argument and distinguish the non-blocking observation from a bounded positive wait.  The production was not changed.
failures.observed: the wrapper of queue.Queue.get did not implement the signature of the queue

failures.assertion: assert isinstance(parallel, dict), 'the timeout did not stay a parallel fact of the failure'
failures.detail: The published outcome of the worker is earlier than the moment at which the endpoint attaches the parallel fact, so waiting for the outcome is not a consumption barrier.  The consumption of the outcome by the endpoint and the end of the reader of the channel must be established before the attached facts are asserted.
failures.observed: the parallel fact was read before the endpoint had consumed the outcome
